explainBack.question: What do you need to check before flying a drone for a travel vlog, in India and abroad?
rubric: Drone rules are set per country by its aviation authority and change over time, so check the official source for the country you will fly in before the trip, including extra steps for foreign-registered drones or whether you may bring one in at all

India: under the Drone Rules 2021, check the Digital Sky airspace map — green zones need no flight permission (up to 400 ft), yellow zones need air traffic control permission, red zones only with Central Government permission

India: nano drones (up to 250 g) and non-commercial micro drones do not need a remote pilot licence/certificate; other cases need registration (UIN) and a certificate — verify current rules on official sources

US (FAA recreational flyers): pass TRUST and carry proof, fly at or below 400 ft in uncontrolled (Class G) airspace, keep visual line of sight, get LAANC/DroneZone authorization in controlled airspace near airports, and register drones of 250 g or more

EU (EASA open category): register as an operator with the aviation authority of your country of residence if your drone has a camera and is not a toy (even a 249 g DJI Mini), stay under 120 m, and check national no-fly zones

explainBack.question: When do you need permission to film people or places while traveling, and how do you handle it respectfully?
rubric: Rules differ by country and site: restricted/protected areas, airports, ports and railways can require clearance, and sensitive places such as religious sites need local norms checked before filming

Filming at protected monuments for films or documentaries needs permission from the site authority (in India, the Archaeological Survey of India, with a fee), and foreign crews shooting documentaries in India need prior approval and a J visa — check the country's rules for your kind of shoot
A model release is a signed permission from identifiable people to use their image; it matters most for commercial use and is always signed by a parent/guardian for minors
Ask for consent before filming someone up close, accept a 'no' without argument, and take extra care with children and elders

YouTube's privacy guidelines let a uniquely identifiable person file a privacy complaint; YouTube weighs factors like public interest and consent and may give the creator a chance to remove the video or blur faces

explainBack.question: How do you protect your footage while traveling for weeks?
rubric: Follow the 3-2-1 rule: 3 copies of your files, on 2 different types of media, with 1 copy off-site (e.g. cloud or another location)
Offload cards every day and verify the copies (ideally with checksum-verifying software) before a card is formatted and reused
Format cards in the camera rather than deleting files on a computer, and stop using a card that shows errors
Carry several smaller cards rather than one huge card, and keep them in a case with a system to tell used from empty
Keep backup drives in different bags, and upload to the cloud when bandwidth allows (often selected files or proxies while travelling)
